input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset in the deployed environment, so password reset (and other) email links point at localhost for every recipient. PUBLIC_URL needs to be set correctly in production config, and ideally templates.ts should fail loudly (or use a required config value) instead of silently defaulting to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is unset, so password reset (and other) email links point at localhost for users instead of the real app URL. This likely surfaced after last week's release if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable stopped being set or was renamed in deployment config.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL (or equivalent configured base URL, e.g. via config.ts) is always set correctly in production environments, and consider making templates.ts fail loudly (throw or log an error) if no production base URL is configured, rather than silently falling back to localhost. This would prevent broken links in password reset, rollup, and scheduled export emails.
